sentences.en: They asked Juha to give a sermon to the people.

sentences.ar: وقف قدامهم وسأل: بتعرفوا شو بدي أحكي؟
sentences.en: He stood in front of them and asked: do you know what I am going to say?
They said: no, we do not know.

sentences.ar: قال: وأنا كمان ما بعرف. سلامتكم.
sentences.en: He said: and I also do not know. Goodbye.
The next week he asked them the same question.

sentences.ar: قال: إذا بتعرفوا، ما في داعي أحكي.
sentences.en: He said: if you know, there is no need for me to speak.

sentences.ar: الأسبوع التالت، نص الناس قالوا بنعرف.
sentences.en: The third week, half the people said we know.
And the other half said we do not know.

sentences.ar: اللي بيعرف يحكي للي ما بيعرف.
sentences.en: Whoever knows should tell whoever does not know.
